boundedTeamRowAuthorization.temperatureReason: Team member list and membership request authorization.
boundedTeamRowAuthorization.reason: Mechanical reuse of the existing team-member owner (BeginTeamMemberRequestRead) with literal installed team-ID resolution (ResolveTeamID) and the shared ErrResourceAccessChanged retry with API-key reauthentication; a team row may stay visible to an admin who cannot read that private team's content. Every caller path is certified on this branch: the team member routes (TestTeamMembershipAuthorization, escaped TestEscapedTeamAuthorizationDifferential), the workspace team membership route (TestMembershipAuthorization, escaped TestEscapedMembershipAuthorization with id, alias, private, missing and empty refs), the escaped team resource row (TestTeamResourceRouteDifferential and its cancellation/boundary test) and the fallback team-row shape for /api/teams/{id}/... and /api/workspaces/{key}/teams/{teamId}/... (TestFallbackAuthorizationDifferential, warm and SQL-reloaded, with key and lowercase-alias refs, retired, child, private and missing teams and a foreign path), all legacy-equal with zero full decodes.
